seg.seg_note: Two reportable segments: Moody's Investors Service (MIS) and Moody's Analytics (MA). From 1-Jan-2022 MA revenue is reported by Decision Solutions (DS) / Research and Insights (R&I) / Data and Information (D&I), replacing RD&A / ERS; prior-year (2021) LOB revenue recast by the company. MIS LOBs: Corporate Finance, Structured Finance, Financial Institutions, Public, Project and Infrastructure Finance, MIS Other. Segment Adjusted Operating Income (release segment table) = total segment revenue incl. intersegment less Operating + SG&A; it excludes D&A and restructuring. MIS intersegment revenue = royalty charged to MA (10-K: 'Intersegment royalty'). mis_dna/ma_dna/mis_restr/ma_restr from the release segment table. Recurring/transaction split and LOB revenue from the release Table 'Transaction and Recurring Revenue'. seg.legacy holds the 10-Q/10-K sub-LOB detail (CFG/SFG/FIG/PPIF sub-lines).
